messages:
maia: Quick thread to finalize webinar flow, speaker assignments, and post-demo Q&A routing for next Thurs. Topic: "Zero-friction LLM serving — tradeoffs, ops, and real-world numbers". Need to lock the run-of-show and who's owning slides/metrics.

trevor: Ok. Primary ask: short product demo (6-8m), two speaker talks (10m each), then 20m panel + 10m live Q&A. Keep total ~55m including intros.

sam: I'm fine for the demo if we keep it focused: one customer example + live dashboard showing latency/cost curves. Will need prod console access and anonymized metrics.

elena: I'll do the first talk on routing & fallbacks (10m). Ross, you OK to do quantization/cost optimizations for the second slot?

ross: Yep. I'll cover batching, KV-caching, and a 2-slide cost comparison. Can we get a 1-slide model-variant table to plug in?

maia: @sam can you prep the dashboard snippet and share by Tue EOD? We need to rehearse Wed.

sam: Yes — sharing a short recording + the live dashboard creds in internal meet notes. Will scrub PII and add synthetic labels.

elena: For Q&A routing: recommend we use the built-in registration form to capture intent (checkboxes: evaluation, POC, pricing). Then route leads: POCs -> solutions-eng, pricing -> sales, evals -> growth SDRs.

trevor: Agree. Also add an extra hidden field for account size so Sales can prioritize. Who's owning the lead mapping and SFDC field names?

jess: I'll own lead mapping. Send me the form JSON and the expected field names. We use: lead_source=webinar, intent, company_size_bucket.

maia: Run-of-show draft (timestamps relative to start):
00:00 - 02:00 - Maia intro + housekeeping
02:00 - 10:00 - Sam: live demo (dash + example)
10:00 - 12:00 - short break/interop slide (ops)
12:00 - 22:00 - Elena: routing/fallbacks
22:00 - 32:00 - Ross: cost & quantization
32:00 - 52:00 - Panel (Trevor moderates) + audience Qs
52:00 - 55:00 - Closing CTA + lead form push

trevor: Panel: Elena, Ross, Sam + customer rep (TBD). I'll moderate and surface 3 predefined prompts if live Qs slow.

elena: Rehearsal plan: 30m tech check (mic, slides, demo creds) 24h before; full dress rehearsal 60m on Wed. Please be in the rehearsal channel 10m early.

sam: For demo stability: I'll include a fallback recording to switch to if live execs drop. Also prepping a short script for the console demo to avoid surprise queries.

jess: For post-webinar flow: attendees -> immediate thank-you + resources + 1-click request for POC. Hot leads (intent=POC or company_size>1000) go to sales inbox with <24h SLA.

maia: Who's prepping the event landing page copy / abstract? Need short abstract (1-line + 2 bullets) and speaker bios. Deadline: Tue noon.

ross: I'll draft 1-line abstract and send. Elena can add bio. @jess can we add UTM params to the landing page for source attribution?

jess: Yes — utm_source=webinar, utm_campaign=zero-friction-llm-2026. I'll handle tracking and the post-attendee funnel.

trevor: Any objections to recording the panel and cutting a 3-min highlight clip for LinkedIn? Need consent in the reg form.

elena: Add checkbox "I consent to recording and having my comments used for marketing". Legal OK? @maria-legal

maria-legal: fine w/ checkbox. Also recommend including a short sentence about anonymizing customer data in demos.

maia: Action items recap:
- Sam: demo + scrubbed dashboard + fallback recording (due Tue EOD)
- Ross: cost slides + 1-line abstract (due Tue noon)
- Elena: slides + bio + consent language (due Tue noon)
- Jess: form + lead mapping + tracking (due Tue EOD)
- Trevor: panel prep + moderator prompts (due Wed morning)
- Maia: landing page + send calendar invite for rehearsals (today)

maia: Cool — if no objections I'll lock this and create the rehearsal event. :thumbsup:
